name: Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026
description: An index of US state and ABA ethics opinions, committee guidelines and court rulings on lawyer advertising and marketing, from 2004 to 2026 (most from 2015 on, plus earlier landmarks): lead generators, pay-per-lead, reviews, testimonials, trade names, websites, social media, chatbots and AI tools, competitor keywords and more. Version 1.1 adds an AI sub-index: 14 AI opinions coded on six marketing questions (chatbot disclosure, AI-made ads, intake and solicitation, superiority claims, confidentiality in marketing tools, and fees). Each record gives the issuing body, number, date, topics, a one-sentence holding in our words, a practical step, whether it is still in force, the official link, an exact short quote and the date read. It is not the opinions' full text. Version 2.1 adds a table of AI guidance for lawyers by jurisdiction (ai-guidance.csv and ai-guidance.json): what official AI guidance for lawyers from 31 jurisdictions says on six marketing questions, each answer a verbatim quote with its place in the document, and 10 jurisdictions with no statewide AI guidance for lawyers in the bar's or court's ethics opinion or guidance index read on November 13, 2026.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026 (Version 2.2.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24367616

distribution.name: opinions.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: opinions.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: opinions-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in opinions-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to opinions.csv on id.

distribution.name: ai-guidance.csv
distribution.description: AI guidance for lawyers by jurisdiction: one line per answer (verbatim quote, or not addressed by the documents listed) for six marketing questions, for the jurisdictions whose official AI guidance for lawyers is quoted, and one line per jurisdiction with no statewide AI guidance for lawyers in the ethics opinion or guidance index read (dated).

recordSet.name: opinions
recordSet.description: The records of Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: body
field.description: The body that issued the opinion

field.name: opinionType
field.description: formal, advisory, informal, committee-guideline or court

field.name: bindingWeight
field.description: How much weight it carries: advisory-committee, committee-guideline or court

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: whatToDo
field.description: What a law firm should do about it, in one sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
